categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in container truck transportation, general truck transportation, fuel station operations, wholesale of gasoline and diesel, gas station operations, real estate development and leasing (residential, industrial, commercial buildings), wholesale and retail of electrical appliances and furniture, and hospitality services through its subsidiary operating an international tourist hotel with related dining and event facilities.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes professional fleet management and computerized operation systems for efficient container transportation across major Taiwanese ports. It emphasizes safety and quality in hazardous chemical and fuel transportation. In real estate, it focuses on development, planning, and construction with strict contract management. The hospitality segment emphasizes high-quality service, facility upgrades, and diversified dining experiences, supported by professional management and marketing strategies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include shipping companies, manufacturers, and traders requiring container and hazardous goods transportation, real estate buyers and tenants in Taipei, Hsinchu, and Taichung regions, and business and leisure travelers utilizing hotel and dining services. The company serves domestic markets primarily, with the hospitality segment targeting both domestic and international tourists, including business travelers and FIT (free independent travelers).
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are concentrated in Taiwan, with transportation services covering major ports in Keelung, Taichung, and Kaohsiung. Real estate development focuses on the Greater Taipei area, Hsinchu, and Taichung. The hospitality business is centered in Taipei City. The company’s supply chain and customer base are primarily domestic, with some international exposure through the hotel’s foreign guests.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments: providing inland container transportation and logistics services, real estate development and leasing, and hospitality services. It acts as a service provider linking upstream shipping and manufacturing with downstream customers and end consumers in real estate and tourism sectors.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding operational efficiency in container transportation, exploring cross-industry cooperation, and offering value-added services to break traditional logistics limitations. The company pursues cautious real estate development focusing on quality residential projects in key urban areas. In hospitality, it aims to enhance brand value and management efficiency. Although it does not have formal R&D expenditures due to business nature, it invests in innovation, human capital development, and sustainability initiatives including energy management and ESG compliance.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through service fees from container and truck transportation, leasing and sales of real estate properties, and hospitality services including room rentals, dining, event hosting, and related amenities. The company also earns income from fuel sales and wholesale operations. Dividend income from investments contributes to non-operating income.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a stable position in Taiwan’s container transportation market with recognized service quality and flexible fleet dispatching. It competes in real estate cautiously amid market fluctuations and government regulations. In hospitality, it is positioned as a high-quality business and tourist hotel in Taipei with strong brand recognition, competing with other local and international hotels. The company leverages cross-industry alliances and resource integration to enhance competitiveness.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$687 million, an 11% increase from the previous year. Operating losses narrowed significantly, while net profit after tax decreased by 31% due to lower dividend income from investments. Total assets were about NT$4.43 billion with equity around NT$3.17 billion. The company shows steady growth in core operations, with cautious capital expenditure and a focus on improving operational efficiency and profitability.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes safe, reliable, and prompt inland container transportation supported by professional fleet management and strategic port presence. Its real estate projects focus on quality, location, and consumer needs to build brand strength. The hospitality segment offers spacious, elegantly designed accommodations with comprehensive services and unique garden features, targeting business and leisure travelers seeking premium experiences. Sustainability and ESG commitments further differentiate the company by aligning with modern environmental and social expectations.
